segments.sn15.6:1.2: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā … pe … ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn15.6:1.5: So na sukaro saṅkhātuṃ ettakāni vassāni iti vā … pe … ettakāni vassasatasahassāni iti vā”ti.
segments.sn15.6:2.3: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhu, āyasaṃ nagaraṃ yojanaṃ āyāmena yojanaṃ vitthārena yojanaṃ ubbedhena, puṇṇaṃ sāsapānaṃ guḷikābaddhaṃ [cūḷikābaddhaṃ (sī. pī.)].
segments.sn15.6:2.4: Tato puriso vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena ekamekaṃ sāsapaṃ uddhareyya.
segments.sn15.6:2.5: Khippataraṃ kho so, bhikkhu mahāsāsaparāsi iminā upakkamena parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya, na tveva kappo.
segments.sn15.6:2.7: Evaṃ dīghānaṃ kho, bhikkhu, kappānaṃ neko kappo saṃsito, nekaṃ kappasataṃ saṃsitaṃ, nekaṃ kappasahassaṃ saṃsitaṃ, nekaṃ kappasatasahassaṃ saṃsitaṃ.
segments.sn15.6:2.9: Anamataggoyaṃ, bhikkhu, saṃsāro … pe … alaṃ vimuccitun”ti.

lines: Chaṭṭhe āyasaṃ nagaranti āyasena pākārena parikkhittaṃ nagaraṃ, na pana anto āyasehi ekabhūmikādipāsādehi ākiṇṇanti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
Anto pana sabbaso vicittasāsapehi eva puṇṇaṃ, evaṃ cuṇṇikābaddhaṃ.
